entities.name: CD34 antigen
observations: The 384-aa query sequence matches mammalian CD34 antigen homologs across its full length, with 65.9–81.5% identity and E-values of 8.43e-146 to 2.14e-200.
The query contains a CD34_antigen Pfam domain spanning residues 188–384.
Curated homolog annotations describe CD34 as a possible adhesion molecule involved in early hematopoiesis and presentation of carbohydrate ligands to selectins.
Curated homolog localization is a single-pass type I membrane protein at the plasma membrane and external cell surface.

The N-terminal sequence is signal-peptide-like, and the C-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with a membrane anchor; the intervening region is rich in Ser/Thr and likely extensively O-glycosylated.
Sequence-derived properties: length 384 aa, molecular weight about 40.25 kDa before modifications, theoretical pI 5.29, predicted net charge at pH 7 about -9.0.

entities.name: Early hematopoiesis
observations: CD34 homolog annotations associate the protein with attachment of hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells to bone marrow extracellular matrix or stromal cells.

entities.name: Cell adhesion
observations: CD34 homolog annotations include cell-cell adhesion, cell-matrix adhesion, and leukocyte migration-related processes.
